evidence.note: SIGMA reframes token-efficient RL as a classical exploration-exploitation problem: a self-imitation exploitation module prioritizes training on prompts/rollouts with high compression potential via a dynamic priority table and a compression-ratio-weighted self-imitation loss, while a self-guidance exploration module directs otherwise-undirected long-response exploration via prompt-based token-budget regeneration or random truncation -- improving average accuracy by 7.9%/2.9% while cutting average reasoning length 43.4%/40.3% on 1.5B/7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill models across six benchmarks, beating eight RL-based efficient-reasoning baselines.
evidence.title: Exploration-Exploitation Reshaping towards Efficient Reasoning for Large Language Models
